description: This file defines the MigrationAPI class which handles REST API requests related to database migration versions within the OrangeHRM installer upgrader module. It includes methods for retrieving available migration versions and executing migrations based on provided version data.

classes.name: MigrationAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class responsible for handling migration version related requests during system upgrade.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve migration versions within a specified range, optionally including the current version.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to execute a migration for a specified version or range of versions, logging the action.
